summary: Megan Kies, 31, of Lafayette, Colorado, was struck by a dislodged rock while climbing the Martha's Couloir route on Mt. Lady Washington, suffering multiple life-threatening injuries; she was lowered ~240 ft to the base of the climb and another 100 ft to a scree slope above Chasm Lake
location: Rocky Mountain National Park, Mt. Lady Washington
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park Search and Rescue
notes: Date corrected 2017-10-01(approx) -> 2017-10-29 (Sunday-verified) per NPS release. MERGE run469: NPS Nov-3-2017 release appended (Kies struck at ~11 a.m. Sunday Oct 29; roped in; partner + two climbers aided; RMNP SAR arrived 2 p.m., advanced life support, litter evacuation with bystander help).
